protocol.study: finite-horizon high-probability online help control under deployment shift (TELEMACHUS docs/online_guarantee.md, Theorem B)
protocol.gate: learned (DAgger, trained on the nominal world only)
protocol.p0_source: declared before held-out runs; nominal full-help failure in certified_help runs was <= 0.074 per seed; the earlier shift study measured full-help failure 0.056-0.075 on these seeds

online_update.rule: theta <- min(1.01, theta - eta * (chunk_failure - alpha_star)), no lower clip

protocol.alpha_star: solved per seed before deployment from (alpha, delta, p0, n, K, eta, theta_nominal)
protocol.also_measured: gate AUC (entropy, margin, learned) for a wrong own action on held-out seeds, nominal and shifted worlds
protocol.selection_statement: p0, eta and K were set from feasibility of alpha* only (no held-out outcomes of this rule were seen).
